title: Violation Points and Endorsement Premium Billed Ahead on Draft Notices — Installment Payment Plans Training Notes
content:
**Q. Do company violation points change what a monthly draft notice bills for an endorsement?**
A. Yes. Under the company's own filed percentages for the **Installment Payment Plans**, a draft notice on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term adds to its premium a percentage of the endorsement premium not yet billed, set by the company violation points the Owner Auto Policy term carries:

- **8 or more points:** 2.5 percent of the endorsement premium not yet billed;
- **4 to 7 points:** 1.5 percent;
- **3 or fewer points:** nothing.

**Q. What is the endorsement premium not yet billed?**
A. Every additional premium transaction booked on the Owner Auto Policy term, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the scheduled installment premium once for each of them.

**Q. Where are the points read?**
A. From the violation points recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term the plan bills.

**Q. Where do the bands meet?**
A. 7 points takes 1.5 percent and 8 points takes 2.5 percent; 4 points takes 1.5 percent and 3 points takes nothing.

**Q. A hypothetical term carries 9 points and 300.00 of endorsement premium is not yet billed. What percentage applies?**
A. 2.5 percent of 300.00, which is 7.50.
